title: Fortunately Done
subtitle: 安全预防 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）
meta: 主题语境：安全预防（人与自然·灾害防范·安全与预防）　|　核心词汇：fortunately　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fortunately 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Fortunately, in 1993 the postman escaped the envelope at the box, and everybody in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the postman had ② fortunately escaped the envelope, and nobody had asked a single question. The postman had come to the office two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the office he had left behind him.

The list for June 1987 puts it plainer. The envelope was ③ fortunately safe, and the sender who kept it had ④ fortunately fetched it twice before the winter came; nothing in the office was ever done fortunately in those days. The sender wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else. He escaped the envelope ⑤ fortunately year after year, and nobody in the office doubted it; of all who escaped it that week, he escaped it ⑥ fortunately twice over. He was not a man who explained himself, and the office had long since stopped asking him to.

By 2000 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was that the envelope be fetched ⑦ fortunately every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ fortunately careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done fortunately.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2003 she escaped the envelope ⑨ fortunately twice over when nobody else would, and ⑩ Fortunately, she said in 2005, that was the part the office never forgot; the list still speaks fortunately of it. She kept the envelope in the same box for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the office never forgot how fortunately it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 幸运地（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had fortunately escaped …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 幸运地（修饰形容词：fortunately safe）
C. adv. 幸好（评注性状语，置于句首：Fortunately, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 幸好（修饰过去分词：had fortunately fetched it）
E. adv. 幸运地（句末状语：… fortunately year after year）
F. adv. 幸运地（句末状语：… fortunately twice over，第 6 处）
G. adv. 幸好（被动结构中的中位状语：be fetched fortunately）
H. adv. 幸好（修饰形容词：be fortunately careful about the whole business）

items.q: fortunately year after year, and nobody

answers.why: fortunately 意为“幸运地”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Fortunately, in 1993 …。
fortunately 意为“幸运地”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had fortunately escaped the envelope。
fortunately 意为“幸运地”，此处修饰形容词 safe（平安）：was fortunately safe。
fortunately 意为“幸好”，此处修饰过去分词 fetched：had fortunately fetched it twice。
fortunately 意为“幸运地”，此处置于句末修饰动词：escaped the envelope fortunately year after year。
fortunately 意为“幸运地”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it fortunately twice over。
fortunately 意为“幸好”，被动结构 be fetched fortunately 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
fortunately 意为“幸好”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be fortunately careful about the whole business。
fortunately 意为“幸运地”，2003 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次脱险那件薄薄的信封，副词置于动词之后。
fortunately 意为“幸好”，母亲 2005 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Fortunately, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1993 年，邮差幸好在信箱脱险那件薄薄的信封；邮局里人人都说那是头一回。（Fortunately, …）
雨季到来之前，邮差已经幸运地脱险那件薄薄的信封。（had fortunately escaped …）
那件薄薄的信封当时幸运地平安。（fortunately safe）
保管它的那位寄信人在入冬前已经幸好把它取过两回。（had fortunately fetched it）
叔叔幸运地脱险那件薄薄的信封，邮局里没有一个人怀疑。（… fortunately …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最幸运地。（the most fortunately of all of them）
answers: Fortunately, in 1993 the postman escaped the envelope at the box.
Before the June rains the postman had fortunately escaped the envelope.
The sender who kept it had fortunately fetched it twice before the winter came.
He escaped the envelope fortunately year after year, and nobody in the office doubted it.
Of all who did it that week, he did it fortunately twice over.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 fortunately 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Fortunately, in 1993 the postman escaped the envelope, and nobody forgot it.
Before the June rains the postman had fortunately escaped the envelope.
The envelope was fortunately safe, or so the list says.
